data.body: 2026-09-05 recurrence during epic rubbery-glacial-cowbird: `summary` for six known story aliases remained live without output for more than three minutes while async plan reviews and concurrent ticket writes were active; the caller cancelled the read to avoid indefinite client occupancy. A preceding six-way `list_tickets(parent=...)` MCP read completed in about 113 seconds but resolved only one alias parent, returning zero rows for five known non-empty stories. Local CLI fallback activated. Investigate serialized sync/contention and alias handling under concurrent gate/write load.
